sentences.text:
For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Md. Musowir, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Jitendra Kumar Singh, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Dr. Anshuman
 Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. The petitioner seeks regular bail in connection with Amdabad P.S. Case No. 157 of 2023, lodged on 15.06.2023 under Sections 341, 323, 420, 504, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and u/s 67 of I.T. Act.

3. As per the prosecution case, the FIR has been lodged against 2 named accused persons including the present petitioner and the specific allegation is against the co-accused Md. Imam who created obscene video of the informant and co- accused Md. Imam with the help of the petitioner, created hindrance in the marriage of the informant and upon query by the informant's father, they abused and threatened to destroy Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.68462 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023 him as well as the life of the informant.
4.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
He further submits that as per the FIR, the petitioner is a major and the allegation of creation of video is upon co-accused namely Md. Imam and not against the present petitioner.
He further submits that the antecedent of the petitioner is clean and he is in custody since 22.07.2023.
